name: Putrika 1st.cut:The Reason She Must Perish
original_name: プトリカ 1st.cut:The Reason She Must Perish
source:
[quote]--I'm not human. They call me a devil.[/quote]

The story begins with a shocking confession between Remi, a boy who works as a jewelry engineer who was raised by demons, and Lazriel, a girl who loses her memory.
She follows Remi's guidance and begins to live her peaceful life, but soon she is plagued by inexplicable dreams. In her dream, she was called Ilsa and was a devoted believer with deep faith in the Archangel.

[quote]You're lying! Pretending that the devil exists![/quote]

People doubt the existence of witches, and an insanity trial begins.
A drama about a girl's crazy pure love that is finally revealed as innocent people are executed due to false charges.

[quote]Even though I know this love is forbidden...[/quote]

And you will know the truth.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2818450]Steam[/url]]
